item.title: Counting Begins Soon for Jubilee Hills and Nuapada Bypolls
item.description: Counting for the bye-elections in Telangana’s Jubilee Hills and Odisha’s Nuapada Assembly seats will begin shortly.

item.title: Red Fort Blast: Video of Bomber Umar Mohammad Surfaces
item.description: A week after the deadly blast near Delhi’s Red Fort that killed 13 people, a disturbing video of the bomber, Dr Umar Mohammad alias Umar-un-Nabi, has surfaced.

item.title: 42 Indian Umrah Pilgrims From Hyderabad Killed in Horrific Bus Accident in Saudi Arabia
item.description: A terrible tragedy struck early Monday morning when a bus carrying Indian Umrah pilgrims from Mecca to Madinah collided with a diesel tanker in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Cyclone ‘Senyar’ Forms Near Indonesia; Heavy Rain Likely in Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Andaman Islands
item.description: A deep depression over the Strait of Malacca intensified into Cyclonic Storm ‘Senyar’ on Wednesday, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) said.

item.title: Govt Asks Smartphone Makers to Preload Sanchar Saathi App
item.description: The telecom ministry has directed smartphone companies to preload a government cyber-security app, Sanchar Saathi, on all new phones sold in India.
